config.node_hull: smallest coordinate hull of grid centers in each node; singleton is exact center
config.prior: uniform over 256 center points; node mass is number of grid points / 256
config.task_rule: s1=3; after lead task t, s_(t+1)=(s_t+r_t+1) mod 9 where r_t is lead task final output; controls replay the same realized count sequence
config.randomness: deterministic Python random.Random bit fixture; exact-law arguments are conditional on ideal iid fair bits; consumed tapes are public
config.float_usage: only wall-clock measurement; exact decisions and outputs use Fraction/integer arithmetic
config.learner_access: no full-grid table; source is only paid node interval execution and exact queried point evaluations where method explicitly pays for them
